# HorizonShift AI

> HorizonShift AI builds custom AI and automation systems for business owners who are the bottleneck in their own operations.

## What We Do

We identify the exact workflows eating your time — lead intake, follow-up, invoicing, scheduling, operations — and automate them with custom-fit AI systems. No bloated software. No templates. Built specifically for your business.

## Who We Help

Small to mid-size business owners in real estate, professional services, agencies, and other ops-heavy industries who are tired of being the bottleneck in their own company.

## Results

- 20–31 hours per week reclaimed by automating inbound lead handling and operations
- 40–67% reduction in invoicing errors through automated billing workflows
- Businesses scale volume without adding headcount

## The Process

1. **Free Audit Call** — 30–60 minutes to map your bottlenecks and identify automation opportunities
2. **Custom System Build** — integrated with your existing tools, not a copy-paste template
3. **Handoff & Support** — you get the time back, we stay on call

## Founder

Markos — Founder of HorizonShift AI. Grew up inside a small business. Built HorizonShift to give operators their time back.
